issues.description: The Bitmap24::save method has a return-type mismatch in the template repository: the header declares it as returning int, but the implementation defines it as void. The solution repository uses void in the header (and implementation). This mismatch in the template will cause compilation errors and confuse students about the intended API (they will see an int declaration but the provided implementation and reference solution use void).
issues.suggested_fix: Make the template header consistent with the implementation and solution by changing the declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);'. Alternatively, if an int return is intended pedagogically, change the implementation to return int and update the solution and usage accordingly — but the simplest fix (and the one matching the solution) is to use void in the template header.
